release_notes:
## Trackpad scrolling works now
- Two-finger scrolling on a trackpad does something. Newer versions of the UI toolkit send trackpad gestures as a completely different kind of event from a mouse wheel, and the app was only listening for the mouse wheel one — so the scrollbar could be dragged by hand but two fingers did nothing. Both are handled now

## Checking for existing episodes should be much faster again
- The check was asking Premiere for each already-nested episode's full location in the project, once per episode. Reading that rebuilds an item's entire folder path from scratch every single time, so with 60-90 episodes already nested it was doing 60-90 of those — and searching every sequence in the project to find them in the first place
- It now reads the DELIVERY > FINAL bin's contents directly, which answers the same question without any of that. Episodes filed in an Archive folder are still ignored, exactly as before
- If the DELIVERY > FINAL bin can't be found, it falls back to the old search rather than concluding that no episodes exist — that mistake would have meant overwriting without asking
